task.title: To assign apps to runtime users in Salesforce

step.cmd: In the Force.com app menu, click X-Author for Excel.
Click Assign next to the newly created app.
Check the boxes for the appropriate users or profiles.

postreq.p: If you have a large number of users in your organization, as an alternative to the manual steps listed below, you may contact your Conga representative for a copy of the X-Author App and App Assignment application. This app was built to enable Admins to quickly assign Users or Profiles to any X-Author for Excel App.
